# Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Links to a GitHub issue or accepted spec.
- [ ] Keeps signing credentials, personal data, and restricted assets out of the public repo.
- [ ] Updates docs/specs when behavior changes.
- [ ] Adds or updates gameplay and content tests.
- [ ] Records new assets in `assets/manifest/assets.csv`.
- [ ] Confirms asset licenses allow public redistribution.
- [ ] Covers the affected 4–6, 7–9, and 10–12 experience where relevant.
- [ ] Runs repository validation, Swift tests, formatting, and affected app builds.
